from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashPosition(BaseModel):
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company that filed this report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the cash account as written in the financial statements (e.g. 'Cash', 'Cash and cash equivalents')")
    raw_value: str | None = Field(description="The numeric value reported, as a string to preserve formatting (e.g. '4,766' or '67,122')")
    scale_unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of measurement for the reported value (e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', or 'units')")
    reporting_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial position represents (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")
    context_snippet: str = Field(description="A short excerpt or context string verifying the value found")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_positions: list[CashPosition]
